title: YourMedicals Prescriber Portal
subtitle: Live Healthcare Platform Frontend
description: An enterprise healthcare prescriber portal featuring real-time clinical workflows, order management dashboards, and responsive patient interfaces.
challenges: Integrating real-time medical prescriber data while maintaining low-latency layout rendering and state synchronization across multiple views.
solutions: Implemented caching and prefetching strategies with TanStack Query. Built modular React components styled with Tailwind CSS, compiled using Vite to ensure optimal browser execution speeds.

architectureSteps.title: Layout Construction
architectureSteps.description: Vite compiles React/Astro pages with Tailwind CSS utility styles.

architectureSteps.title: API Integration
architectureSteps.description: Axios requests securely fetch prescriber data from the backend portal.

architectureSteps.title: Data Caching
architectureSteps.description: TanStack Query handles caching and automated validation of clinical endpoints.

architectureSteps.title: Component Rendering
architectureSteps.description: Modular UI elements dynamically render patient dashboards and order workflows.

title: EventElite
subtitle: Full-Stack Event Management Platform
description: Developed a full-stack event management platform with secure authentication, event creation, registration, and user management features.
challenges: Managing concurrent event registrations and preventing double-booking errors during high traffic periods.
solutions: Implemented transaction isolation levels in MySQL queries and optimized database connection pooling.

architectureSteps.title: Frontend Client
architectureSteps.description: Captured registration inputs and managed user session state.

architectureSteps.title: API Route Validation
architectureSteps.description: Express middleware authenticated JWT tokens and sanitized inputs.

architectureSteps.title: SQL Controller
architectureSteps.description: MySQL database stored relational registration and event tables.

title: RentNest
subtitle: Airbnb-Inspired Booking Platform
description: Built an Airbnb-inspired rental booking platform featuring user authentication, property listings, booking workflows, and review management.
challenges: Developing a dynamic UI using EJS templates while handling complex nested documents for reviews and booking status states.
solutions: Designed modular mongoose schemas with subdocuments and pre-save hooks to automatically aggregate review ratings.

architectureSteps.title: EJS Layout rendering
architectureSteps.description: Renders server-side templates with dynamic data inputs.

architectureSteps.title: Express routing
architectureSteps.description: Directs request threads to booking and property controller actions.

architectureSteps.title: Mongoose database
architectureSteps.description: Stores collections for users, listings, bookings, and reviews.
